LBW by the barest of the margins and Bennett yelps in disappointment. Exceptional first over; set him up beautifully for this nip-backer

details.text: Steamrollering in, hits a full-length and gets a nibble in the corridor, rushes stroke, just throws his bat at it and gets a clear outside edge that has been gobbled cleanly by the keeper, no need to double-check, and this is a massive breakthrough, set batter departs, just like Taylor, he also deserved a hundred, will be disappointed miss out on the millstone, but a fantastic innings nevertheless! Gets a huge round of applause from the fans
